design_rationale:
DOSSIER, task 1 (bed_hold_and_leave_reservations, env_0074, rework round 5). frozen_time 2026-11-05 11:15:00 EST.
WHY A GOOD TEST: Marisol Quintero asks only to sign the October bed-hold charge. The September (opening) entry of the same hold carries no charge, and the closing schedule's rule says the closing charge is worked out only after it does; the agent posts that charge first.
WORLD: private-pay admission 2026-02-02 (452-B); infection-control move to private room 437 on 2026-04-14 (isolation placement, isolation-basis billing); Medical Assistance application 2026-06-05 requesting 2026-06-01, agreement converted (medicaid_pending) from 2026-06-01 with the June advance bill credited; the family had not paid the May bill, so the deposit was applied to it on 2026-06-25 and 384.00 remains owed (no late charge or referral while the stay is converted), which keeps the converted agreement open; approval notice 2026-08-03 (eligible from 2026-06-01, patient pay 1476.10), pending accruals settled covered; August 10 hospital stay (3 reserved days, return day booked and reversed); hospitalization from 2026-08-25: the business office counted the 3 August-10 days against it and booked only 12 reserved days, so private days were booked from 2026-09-06 although this hospitalization's 15 reserved days run to 2026-09-08; private extension and written renewal; return 2026-10-14 logged 2026-10-18, when the October entry was booked through 2026-10-17. Late rate notice 2026-08-31 (binds 2026-10-30).
SCOPE: draw [5,6] -> D=5, E=6. D bedhold_ext_hospital_opening_charge (agent, post_hospital_opening_charge_991dca72), E bedhold_ext_hospital_closing_charge (root, user, sign_hospital_closing_charge_702d4c7f).
LEVERS (coordinator round-5 list): rate-notice binding (method, private); extended-hold percent on days already charged (carries D->E); dietary credit keyed to the bed held (multi-source); isolation pricing from the agreement's placement (multi-source, private); MA reserved days per hospitalization (D); census return day and the days after the return (E). The notice rule stays in the baseline.
NEAR-MISSES: the August 10 stay is a separate hospitalization with its own reserved days; its reversal is holding-scoped; the rate notice binds 2026-10-30, after the October entry.
user_scenario: You are Marisol Quintero, seventy-nine, Harold Quintero's wife and the person who handles his bills; you speak slowly and politely and like to have things repeated back to you. Your husband Harold Quintero lives at Keystone Ridge's York center, where Medical Assistance covers his care. He was taken to WellSpan York Hospital on the evening of August 25th and came back to the center in October; while he was in the hospital his bed was held, and you signed to keep holding it privately once Medical Assistance stopped paying for the held days. Now you want to sign the bed-hold charge agreement for October for Harold's room, so that his October bed-hold charge is signed and on his account; that is the one thing you are calling about, and you will do the signing yourself on this call if they send you what you need to sign. You are not paying anything today; you say you will pay when the statement comes. You do not know what the October figure should be, and you do not know whether anything else on the bed-hold side is outstanding. You open by saying who you are and that you want to sign the October bed-hold charge for your husband's held bed. When the agent asks for details, you give his date of birth, June 3, 1941, written 1941-06-03; if they want another detail you give the last four of his Social Security number, 4290; if they ask for the phone number on file it is 717-555-0466. You give these one at a time, as asked. If the agent says other steps have to come first, you say that is fine and let them proceed. Whenever the agent hands you a signing step and tells you the reservation reference, the held-days entry reference, the number of days and the amount, you sign it exactly as given, and you read back the confirmation you get. If the agent tells you a charge figure, you just say "all right". Once the agent tells you the October bed-hold charge is signed and posted, you thank them and end the call.
